en_question: Which of the 다음 설명 concerning 소멸시효 is correct? (If there is a 다툼, follow the 판례.)
en_A: A claim for 손해배상 arising from nonperformance of 채무불이행 does not 소멸 together with the original 채권 even if the original claim is 소멸 by 시효.
en_B: The 청구 concerning work by a 사람 who has undertaken a 계약, to which the 3년 short-term 소멸시효 applies, means only the 청구 for the 가격 of the work, and the contractor’s 청구 for the establishment of a 저당권, as a 청구 incidental to that work, does not fall under a 청구 concerning the work of a 사람 who has undertaken a 계약.
en_C: A junior secured interest holder는 선순위담보권의 피담보채권의 extinction으로 직접 이익을 받는 person이므로 may invoke the 소멸시효의 completion concerning the secured claim under the senior secured interest.
en_D: In a 소송 seeking performance of the 절차 for cancellation registration of 저당권 establishment 등록, brought by a real 보증인 on the ground of the nonexistence or extinction of the 피담보채무, even if the 채권자, who is also the 저당권자, prevails by seeking a 판결 dismissing the claim and asserting the 존재 of the secured claim, the 채권자’s said act of responding to the 소송 does not constitute a "judicial claim," which is a ground for interruption of prescription with respect to the 피담보채권.
en_E: Where a 채권자 attaches or provisionally attaches the 채무자’s claim against a 제3채무자, the effect of 확정적 interruption of prescription arises with respect to the 채무자’s claim against the 제3채무자.

en_A: If A, G의 의사에 반함에도 불구하고, performed a 법률행위 representing J in the 공동명의 of H and G, that 법률행위 is ineffective regardless of whether the 상대방 acted in good faith.
en_B: If J이 G과 H의 동의 없이 신용카드 use 계약 with 카드 회사 L and obtained a 카드 without the consent of G and H, and L paid the price for 물품 purchased from Q using that 카드, then after G과 H rescinded the 신용카드 use contract with L, but did not rescind the sales contract with Q and J consumed all of the purchased 물품, J does not bear an 의무 to return 부당이득 to L.
en_C: If, at the time of the 법률행위, J merely told the 상대방 that he was an 성년자 and did not actively use 속임수, J may 취소 the above juristic 행위.
en_D: After G의 death, H, in order to secure the 채무 of a 주식회사 of which B is the representative director, established a 근저당권 over the co-owned 재산 of H and J in the capacity of J's 법정대리인 without appointing a 특별대리인, and such act is a 이해상반행위 and therefore 무효이다.
en_E: After G의 사망, even if H, as the legal 대표 of J and K, reaches an agreement to divide the 상속재산 so that all of it becomes K의 sole property, such 분할 by agreement is 적법.

en_A: If J이 G에게 performance of the 채무를 청구하였으나, G argues that because he had not granted 대리권 to H, he is under no 채무 to perform, J must prove that H had authority to sell X 토지.
en_B: If H이 수령한 the balance from the buyer J, then, 특별한 circumstances, J’s obligation to pay the 잔금 is 소멸한다 even if H did not remit the 잔금 to G.

en_D: If G이 주장하기를 the above 매매계약 was concluded at a 가액 markedly lower than 시장 가치 and is 무효 as an unfair 법률행위, the 궁박 requirement is determined based on G, and the 경솔/무경험 requirement is determined based on H.
